0:
[upsmon]
  password  = "${NUT_PASSWORD}"
  actions = SET
  instcmds = ALL
  upsmon primary
[homeassistant]
  password = "${HASS_NUT_PASSWORD}"
  actions = SET
  instcmds = ALL

[kubernetes]
  driver = usbhid-ups
  port = auto
  desc = "Cyber Power System, Inc. PR1500LCDRT2U UPS"
  pollinterval = 10

MONITOR kubernetes@localhost:3493 1 upsmon "${NUT_PASSWORD}" primary
SHUTDOWNCMD "/sbin/shutdown -h +0"
POWERDOWNFLAG /etc/killpower
POLLFREQ 15
POLLFREQALERT 5
HOSTSYNC 15
